params.body:
Nightwatch 86: `stocklist:check-transactions` named vehicle 24218 as a buy-over without its `vehicle_history` row ("both garages miss their order form and confirmation mail").

Nothing was missed. 24218 is a copy (`duplicated_from_id = 23524`). 23524 was bought over from 19568 on 15 October 2026 and carries its row (253); it was sold, and the copy put the car back on the sheet.

`OwnStockController::duplicateVehicle` copies every field except a fixed list, and `seller_vehicle_id` and `seller_id` are not on it. So a copy of a bought-over sheet looks like a second purchase of the same car: to the daily check, to the buy-over counts in Inzichten and DealerUsage, to seller voting and to the transport pick-up location. On production two copies carry a `seller_vehicle_id`.

`create:vehicle-history` must not be run on them: it would write a purchase that never happened.

Wanted: copying leaves both fields out, and a dry-run command clears them on the copies that already inherited them.
params.title: A copy of a bought-over sheet counts as a second purchase
